name: Housecall Pro
summary: Field service software for home-service companies, with three published plans.
differentiator: Publishes all three plan prices and says a price book and Good-Better-Best options come with every plan, so a small shop can see its full software cost before it talks to anyone.
pricing: Basic $59 a month on annual billing ($79 monthly), 1 user. Essentials $149 ($189 monthly), 5 users. Max $299 ($329 monthly), 8 users and $35 a month for each extra user.

scope.takeoff: None described on the pages we read.
scope.library: Price book and Good-Better-Best options on all three plans. No electrical database is described.
scope.laborUnits: Not stated on the pages we read.

materialPrices.note: Quotes use a price book you maintain. No price feed is named.

bestFor: Residential service and repair electricians who quote from their own price book.
skipIf: You bid plans and specs and need takeoff.
watchOut: Annual billing prices are lower than the monthly prices shown.
Its "best electrician apps" article on the same site is vendor content.
